newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish wholesales, retail sales surge in July.
newsitem.headline: Finnish wholesales, retail sales surge in July.

text.p: The volume of Finnish wholesales rose 6.7 percent year-on-year in July and the value excluding value-added tax (VAT) of these sales rose 9.0 percent, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Monday.
The volume of retail sales rose 8.4 percent year-on-year in July and the value excluding VAT of these sales rose 9.2 percent, SF said.
"July was a clearly livelier month than last year both in wholesales and in retail sales," SF said.
Automobile wholesales increased nearly one-fifth, and wholesales of hardware and construction materials -- long in the doldrums -- rose 11 percent year-on-year.

In retailing, automobile sales soared 35 percent compared with the same month last year, sales of shoes rose 17 percent and electric goods and home electronics sales increased more than 15 percent, SF said.
